rationale: Builds on the current 9x512 staged reverse-tail best with a compact recurrence-scheduling edit. The first recurrent tail pass trains at low gain for the whole 600s run, while the current best evaluates it at gain 1.0; the prior hard cap at 0.72 was a close miss, so this tests a milder 0.90 export/eval cap to reduce train/eval recurrence mismatch while preserving nearly all tail capacity and the existing quant-aware int8+zlib path.
title: Soft-Capped Reverse-Tail Eval Profile
